entries.09144b3d2b20b78f: Kingudamu Ran -Tenka Tōitsu e no Michi-
entries.0e05eebbe9ad612f: It develops and operates smartphone games and undertakes commissioned development. It operates “Gosshikku wa Mahō Otome ~Sassato Keiyaku Shinasai!~” and “Tōhō Gensō Ekuripusu,” and its consolidated subsidiary Deragē Co., Ltd. is involved in operating “Monster Strike” and “Kingudamu Ran -Tenka Tōitsu e no Michi-.” Amounts by category are not separately disclosed.
entries.0fce3fd9ee4e8f71: This business develops, operates and undertakes commissioned work for smartphone games, and plans, produces, sells and licenses derivative works. The business is carried out by the company, its consolidated subsidiaries Deragē Co., Ltd. and DELUXE GAMES SDN.BHD., and the production committee for the smartphone game “Meteo Arena,” and revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended May 2026 was ¥11,021 million. Its head office is located in Meguro-ku, Tokyo.
entries.1f669e8ada86d39c: It provides support and management for video streamers, including internet advertising. Amounts by category are not separately disclosed.
